## [1.5.0](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0) (2026-11-24)

### ✨ New Features

* **soundcloud:** rename Go+ patch to SoundCloud Go and support 2026.11.20 ([c6a14fd](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/commit/c6a14fd783b014bcea13344816a63742bcf70414))

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Changes the default dark theme to use true blacks for AMOLED screens.

patches.name: Disable consent popup
patches.description: Disables the OneTrust consent/cookies popup and collapses banner views.

patches.name: Enable SoundCloud Go
patches.description: Enables the local SoundCloud Go plan controls and the offline_sync, no_audio_ads and hq_audio feature switches, hides Go upsells and fan plan-transition screens, and disables client ad requests and display placements. SoundCloud's servers still decide which streams, downloads and audio quality the account may fetch: high-bitrate audio and encrypted offline copies require a real Go+ subscription.

patches.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches.description: Applies Android 12+ Material You dynamic accent colors from the system wallpaper palette.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables AdMob banner, interstitial and rewarded ads, removes sponsored/promotional banners, and skips advertising consent prompts.
